The drop-in root: it boots, gates and runs every flow the product needs, renders the app once it is licensed, and adds the grace banner, the update prompt and toasts. It starts itself, never flashes the sign-in form before the real state has loaded, and re-renders when the license changes in the background.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-python" />

    **Drop-in.** `status` (needs-activation, not-applicable) and the bare `boot`.

    **Styled part.** `screens.gate(kit, view)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `gate_view(status, now=…)` → `GateView` (component, state, grace, allowed range, holder) in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Node)">
    <KitStatus kit="terminal-node" />

    **Drop-in.** `status` (`statusFlow`) before there is a license (`needs-activation`): the
    commands that get one (`activate`, `login`, `enroll` for a free tier) and exit code 1.
    `checkFlow`, the check a product runs before its own work, prints the `licensed` line or falls
    through to `status`.

    **Styled part.** `problemRows` and `fixRows`.

    **Headless.** `statusView(input)`: PolarisKeyGate `needs-activation` with its `fixes`, or
    `licensed`; `statusExit(status)` says whether the product may go on.

    [Terminal (Node)](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/terminal-node/) has the adapter's options, the
    `--json` contract and the fallbacks.

  </TabItem>
  <TabItem label="SwiftUI">
    **Drop-in.** `ContentView().polarisKeyGate(client)` or `PolarisKeyGate(client) { App() }`: it starts itself, shows `booting` until the first reload (never activation during a cached-session check) and re-renders on `client.events`.

    **Styled part.** `BootView`, `WelcomeView`, `ActivateView`, `SignInView`, `StatusScreenView` and `GraceBannerView` on their own; `PolarisKeyScope(model:)` puts the resolved theme, copy and icon around any of them.

    **Headless.** `PolarisKeyGateModel` (`@Observable`, in `PolarisKeyUICore`): `gate`, `route`, `start()`, `refresh()`; `KitStates.gate(_:)` over `KitInputs`.

    [SwiftUI](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/swiftui/) has the theme, the restyle hooks and the sample.

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
